title.zh: 最多能完成排序的块 II
title.en: Max Chunks To Make Sorted II

desc.zh: 从亲手切分到前缀最大值与后缀最小值，推导所有安全切口。
desc.en: Derive every safe cut using prefix maxima and suffix minima, starting with hand-sorted chunks.

concepts.name: safe partition boundaries
concepts.description: A cut is safe exactly when the entire left maximum does not exceed the entire right minimum.

concepts.name: prefix maximum and suffix minimum
concepts.description: Reuse extrema in two linear passes instead of rescanning every side.

concepts.name: maximality of all safe cuts
concepts.description: All safe boundaries coexist; every legal partition uses only safe boundaries.
